tiers.neutral: Browse. Everything here has a price.
tiers.high: Back again? Good. I set aside the fresh stock for you.

tiers.low: The Bureau does not extend credit to the unrecorded.
tiers.neutral: Requisition forms are on the counter. Try not to bleed on them.
tiers.high: Your file is in good order. The Quartermaster authorizes the good stock.

tiers.low: The Bloom does not trade with the unworthy.
tiers.neutral: Take what the Bloom permits. No more.
tiers.high: The Bloom recognizes you. Its gifts are yours.

tiers.low: You cannot buy a map you are not meant to read.
tiers.neutral: Every route has a toll. Pay it.
tiers.high: For you, the Collective opens the sealed drawers.

tiers.low: Your name is not in the ledger. We do not sell to blank pages.
tiers.neutral: Sign here. The Scribes record every transaction.
tiers.high: Your account is written in full. The archive stock is open to you.
The Null keeps what it sells. You have earned its quiet.
